model_verdict.reason: Goal requests comparing last 7 days sales with the previous 7 days. Verified evidence covers revenue difference (3000-800=2200 TRY), order count difference (3-2=1), item gross amount difference (2200 TRY), item quantity difference (2), and verified greater_than boolean comparisons for revenue and orders across the same account (Pilot Ana, api_account 101, stage environment). Periods are distinct adjacent equal-duration 7-day intervals (1791147600000-1791752399999 vs 1790542800000-1791147599999). Units are consistent TRY and order/marketplace_item counts. Provisional cardinality of 1 undercounts; the comparison requires both amount and count differences plus boolean relations, corrected to 2 calculations with amount/count/boolean result kinds. Stock and finance components are raw observations checked separately, not calculations.
